jupas.shortDescription: an class="before_label">Short Description BA in Chinese studies is a multi-disciplinary, primarily English-taught undergraduate programme which offers an integrated exploration of the complexities of Chinese history, economy, governance, business, culture, literature and contemporary society. With an emphasis on interactive teaching, international exchange, and immersive study, our programme is ideal for students intent on becoming globally-oriented China experts, cross-cultural communicators and network-builders. This major is designed for two streams of students distinguished by Chinese language fluency, i.e. 1) International Stream (IS) and 2) Chinese Native-Speaker Stream (CNSS). Students in each stream pursue a subset of learning offerings tailored to their language capacities while completing most of their course work in a shared learning environment in which international and Chinese-native speaker students learn from each other and pursue collaborative projects together. Special features of the programme include 1) adopting an interdisciplinary approach to exploring Greater China; 2) training students to gain an integrated understanding of China’s past, present, and future; 3) offering interactive instruction in a “liberal arts” mode and immersive learning through “on-the-ground” sociocultural experience in Greater China; 4) emphasizing intensive empirical research to equip students with strong analytical and communication skills; 5) providing an international-oriented network for developing careers in Hong Kong, mainland China, and abroad.

Today, as the most populous country in the world and an emerging superpower, China is a force to reckon with. Hence, there is always great demand for programmes that help students from different cultural backgrounds acquire the essential skills and knowledge for getting a grasp on the many faces of China. It is this awareness of cross-cultural engagement that makes CUHK’s Chinese Studies stand out. With the aim of training global China experts, the BA in Chinese Studies programme was designed to give students an in-depth understanding of China and Chinese communities throughout the world through scholarship and first-hand experience. The programme takes an interdisciplinary approach to guide students to pursue their own paths of investigation into the myriad aspects of China’s history, governance, economy, business, culture, literature and contemporary society in a global context. There is strong emphasis on socio-cultural immersion, on-the-ground research, and an exchange of views among a distinctive mix of learners and faculty from Chinese societies and from around the world. Students are encouraged to broaden their understanding and think critically, and from that basis explore deeply and innovatively. We encourage our students to delve into current social, economic and governmental structures, pursue research on specific cases, and undertake fieldwork or internships to “learn by seeing and doing”. Our students find this approach fascinating. Learning through Cross-Cultural Dialogue Admitting students from around the globe, the programme prizes learning through cross-cultural dialogue and tailored, individualized student development. Local and non-local students take courses and do fieldwork together, while having the chance to work on their individual strengths and weaknesses. From its longstanding position as a site of convergence, multilingualism and cultural exchange, Hong Kong is an ideal place to practise this mixed-learning model. cuhkAdmission.careerProspects: Our programme offers a comprehensive, in-depth understanding of China, equipping students with excellent proficiency in both Chinese (Putonghua) and English, as well as a profound understanding of Chinese society and culture. Students study in a cross-cultural environment and gain an international outlook through diverse fieldwork and in-class learning experiences. Our graduates possess strong analytical and communication skills that make them highly sought-after in today’s competitive job market. Graduates of our programme have a wide range of exciting career opportunities ahead of them. Our alumni have achieved remarkable success in various fields, including media, public policy, business, finance, education, tourism, marketing, academic research and culture management. Many have secured key positions in renowned multinational corporations, such as A.P. Moller – Maersk, Dealogic, Societe Generale, the Maritime Silk Road Society and Ernst & Young, as well as prominent institutions in Hong Kong, like AIA Hong Kong. Their contribution has added significant value to these organizations. Many of our graduates have chosen to pursue advanced academic studies, both locally and internationally. They have been admitted to prestigious universities around the world, including Harvard University, the University of Chicago, Johns Hopkins University, SOAS University of London, and University College London. Locally, many have continued their postgraduate education at esteemed institutions such as The Chinese University of Hong Kong, The University of Hong Kong, The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, and Hong Kong Baptist University. By further expanding their academic horizons, these individuals have continued to make an outstanding contribution to the field of Chinese studies. Through the BA in Chinese Studies programme, our students gain a solid foundation of academic knowledge and practical skills, positioning them for a successful future in their chosen career path. Regardless of their interests and career goals, this programme offers a broad and exciting range of opportunities for personal and professional growth. Join us at the Centre for China Studies and embark on a transformative educational journey that will shape your future and open doors to diverse and rewarding career prospects. If you are interested in this programme, please review the application requirements and deadlines specific to the respective admission scheme to increase your chances of getting accepted. APPLY NOW

curriculum.title: Curriculum
content: The BA in Chinese Studies is a multi-disciplinary, primarily English-taught programme offering an integrated exploration of Chinese history, economy, governance, business, culture, literature and contemporary society.
Two streams: International Stream (IS) and Chinese Native-Speaker Stream (CNSS), tailored to language fluency while sharing most coursework.

Key features: interdisciplinary approach to Greater China; integrated understanding of China’s past, present, future; interactive liberal arts instruction; immersive learning through on-the-ground sociocultural experience; emphasis on empirical research; international career network.
Students complete core courses and electives across disciplines, with fieldwork and exchange opportunities.

campus.title: Campus Life
content: CUHK’s scenic Shatin campus offers a vibrant college system with nine colleges, each providing residential, pastoral, and co-curricular support.
Students benefit from a multicultural environment, with local and international peers learning together.
The programme emphasizes international exchange and immersive study; students may participate in exchange programmes and fieldwork in Greater China.
Facilities include libraries, sports centres, and cultural venues.

competitiveness.title: Competitiveness
content: 2025 JUPAS statistics: Band A offer rate ~8.7% (10 offers from 115 Band A applications).

tips.title: Ace Sir's Chinese Studies Strategy — 9 Actionable Tips
content: **1. Target Score: 24.25+ (Best 5)**
- Median and LQ both 24.25; aim for at least 24 to be competitive.
- Use English weighting (x1.25) to boost score.
**2. Prioritize English and Electives**
- English Level 3 minimum; higher grades significantly improve weighted score.
- Electives at Level 4 or above (especially 5* or 5) strengthen profile.
**3. Chinese and CSD: Meet Minimums**
- Chinese Level 3 required; CSD Attained (or LS Level 2 pre-2024).
- These do not contribute to score but are gatekeeping.
**4. Choose Electives Strategically**
- Two electives at Level 3; consider M1/M2 as one elective.
- Applied Learning with Distinction I/II can be extra subject.
**5. Band A Placement is Critical**
- All 10 offers went to Band A; Band B/C/D/E received zero offers.
- Place JS4136 in Band A to be considered.
**6. Leverage Interdisciplinary Interest**
- Show passion for China’s history, economy, culture in personal statement (if applicable).
- Highlight cross-cultural experiences or language skills.
**7. Prepare for No Interview**
- No interview means DSE scores are decisive; focus on exam performance.
- Still prepare a strong portfolio for scholarship applications.
**8. Explore Exchange and Fieldwork**
- Programme emphasizes immersive learning; mention interest in overseas exchange or Greater China fieldwork.
- This can strengthen your application narrative.
**9. Apply Early and Check Requirements**
- Ensure all subject requirements met; waivers possible for Chinese in special cases.
- Visit programme website (ccs.cuhk.edu.hk) for updates.

curriculum.title: 課程結構
content: 中國研究文學士是一個跨學科、主要以英語授課的本科課程，綜合探討中國歷史、經濟、治理、商業、文化、文學及當代社會的複雜性。
設有兩個分流：國際生分流（IS）及中文母語者分流（CNSS），根據語言能力調整學習內容，大部分課程共同修讀。
主要特色：跨學科視角探索大中華；整合理解中國的過去、現在與未來；互動式博雅教學；透過實地社會文化體驗進行沉浸式學習；強調實證研究；建立國際職業網絡。
學生需完成核心課程及跨學科選修，並參與實地考察及交流機會。
課程網站：http://www.ccs.cuhk.edu.hk

career.title: 就業前景
content: 畢業生具備優秀的分析與溝通能力、中英文（普通話）能力，以及對中國社會文化的深入理解。
就業領域：媒體、公共政策、商業、金融、教育、旅遊、市場營銷、學術研究、文化管理。
僱主包括跨國企業：A.P. Moller – Maersk、Dealogic、Societe Generale、海上絲綢之路協會、Ernst & Young、AIA Hong Kong。
深造院校：哈佛大學、芝加哥大學、約翰霍普金斯大學、倫敦大學亞非學院、倫敦大學學院、香港中文大學、香港大學、香港科技大學、香港浸會大學。

campus.title: 校園生活
content: 香港中文大學位於沙田，校園環境優美，設有九所書院，提供住宿、生活輔導及課外活動支援。
學生可在多元文化環境中與本地及國際同學共同學習。
課程強調國際交流與沉浸式學習；學生可參與交流計劃及大中華地區的實地考察。
校園設施包括圖書館、體育中心及文化場地。

competitiveness.title: 競爭力分析

Band A 申請與錄取比例約 11.5:1。
中位數 24.25（最佳 5 科）顯示競爭激烈；申請者應爭取 24 分以上。
無需面試；錄取基於 DSE 成績及科目加權（英文 x 1.25）。

- 劉兆佳：政治學者，前中央政策組首席顧問。

scholarships.title: 獎學金及資助
content: 香港中文大學為本地 JUPAS 學生提供入學獎學金，根據學業成績頒發，包括全額或部分學費減免。

詳情請瀏覽：https://admission.cuhk.edu.hk/fees-financing-your-studies/
每年學費：HK$47,000（本地）；生活費估計約 HK$62,000（住宿及開支）。

tips.title: Ace Sir 的中國研究策略 — 9 個實用貼士
content: - 中位數及下四分位數均為 24.25；目標至少 24 分以具競爭力。
- 利用英文加權（x1.25）提升分數。
**2. 優先提升英文及選修科**
- 英文需達 3 級；更高級別顯著提高加權分數。
- 選修科達 4 級或以上（尤其 5* 或 5）強化個人檔案。
**3. 中文及公民科：達標即可**
- 中文需 3 級；公民科達標（或 2024 年前通識科 2 級）。
- 這些科目不計入分數，但為入學門檻。
**4. 策略性選擇選修科**
- 兩科選修達 3 級；可考慮 M1/M2 作為一科選修。
- 應用學習達「達標並表現優異 I/II」可作額外科目。
**5. Band A 選擇至關重要**
- 所有 10 個錄取均來自 Band A；Band B/C/D/E 無錄取。
- 將 JS4136 置於 Band A 以獲考慮。
**6. 展現跨學科興趣**
- 在個人陳述（如適用）中表達對中國歷史、經濟、文化的熱忱。
- 突出跨文化經驗或語言能力。
**7. 無需面試準備**
- 無面試意味 DSE 成績決定一切；專注考試表現。
- 仍可準備優秀作品集以申請獎學金。
**8. 探索交流及實地考察機會**
- 課程強調沉浸式學習；在申請中提及對海外交流或大中華實地考察的興趣。
- 這可強化申請敘事。
**9. 提早申請並核實要求**
- 確保滿足所有科目要求；特殊情況下中文可獲豁免。
- 瀏覽課程網站（ccs.cuhk.edu.hk）獲取最新資訊。
